sample-1.desktop: Clear product/search/form groups and labels; plain utilitarian styling. Operations are below the initial viewport.
sample-1.mobile: SKU wraps across several lines. Total and Minimum columns are outside the captured table view; whether internal scrolling exposes them requires source/interaction inspection.

sample-2.desktop: Clear headings and consistent forms, with substantial unused vertical space before stock operations.
sample-2.mobile: SKU and Name columns collapse to very narrow columns with character-by-character wrapping, creating very tall rows. Readability is materially poor despite no page-level horizontal overflow.

visualReview.conclusion: Both screenshots show usable desktop form structure but do not justify an equal or high subjective design-quality claim. The no-page-overflow gate does not measure mobile table readability.
